question.text: The Unique Reference Number (URN) under SAS is:

answer.text: A PAN allotted to the SIA by the Income Tax Department
A unique identifier issued per SIA engagement, tying the Social Impact Report to the specific SE, reporting period and assessor, and disclosed in the AIR
The SSE listing number of the Social Enterprise
A password to access the SEBI SCORES portal

explanation.text: The Logic: The URN is issued per SIA engagement — each SIR / AIR carries its own URN, linking the document to the engaging SE, the reporting period and the SIA. It ensures traceability and prevents impact-report fabrication. Disclosed on the AIR cover and in SSE filings. The Trap: PAN is for tax. SSE listing has its own code but is distinct. SCORES is a complaints portal. Only the engagement-specific identifier matches URN. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII exclusively tests URN; no other NISM exam uses this concept. Expect 2-3 URN-related questions across topics. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Cross-reference the URN in every working-paper index page — if a regulator audits your engagement file three years later, the URN is the thread that ties every file page to the specific engagement.
